results.description: Overview Bitcoin ( BITSTAMP:BTCUSD ) on the 1-Hour timeframe is displaying clear signs of bearish market structure shift (MSS) following a breakdown from its local high and top downward channel. A rejection from this immediate supply zone points toward a high-probability short opportunity targeting the Sell-Side Liquidity (SSL) rested below $63,600. Supply Zone / Resistance: The teal zone (~$64,050 – $64,200) acts as local bearish supply/order block where price is currently finding resistance. Liquidity Targets: SSL (Sell-Side Liquidity): Located around $63,600, marked by recent swing lows (main target). results.title: Delhi Metro Temporarily Closes 18 Stations Amid Security Concerns
results.description: In a significant move, the Delhi Metro Rail Corporation has temporarily closed 18 metro stations in central Delhi due to security concerns stemming from ongoing protests. This decision, effective from 7:30 AM on Saturday, restricts entry and exit at these stations, although interchange services at key locations like Rajiv Chowk and Mandi House will continue. The closure has caused considerable inconvenience for daily commuters, prompting many to seek alternative transport options. DMRC urges passengers to stay updated on the situation and plan their journeys accordingly. The authorities are monitoring the area closely and will provide updates on the reopening of the stations.
